dedupe_keys.name: experimental and numerical study of a large scale water pit thermal energy storage quantifying the impact of progressive lid insulation degradation

description: The documented TRNSYS model represents changing top-lid insulation properties in the Marstal pit thermal energy storage in Denmark. Monitoring from 2013–2017 supports comparison of simulated heat losses and efficiency as moisture and thermal damage progress. The source reports improved agreement when degradation is represented. Its paper documents the model; a public executable, downloadable original observations or a general degradation law for other stores is not established. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Experimental and numerical study of a large-scale water pit thermal energy storage: Quantifying the impact of progressive lid insulation degradation
